## Claims
- [source-backed] Selected provider record: provider `workspace`, record `literature-candidate-1`, stable external identifier `doi:10.1112/jlms.12832`; its exact Abstract field states “We prove the minimality conjecture.” Durable locator: `https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/2209.02011`, content SHA-256 `6066dee1db75213a13ca9c407c8944c09c7391fb0fb69f1d4a386ed4292fc456`. [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 12-18]
- [source-backed] The same full text defines \(i=s-t+1\), \(j=r-t+1\), \(a=\min(n-r-i,r-j)\), \(b=\min(i,j)\), and proves minimality for \(\{\bar s_\mu\mid i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq(i^j,b^a)\}\). [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 95-110]
- [source-backed] The supplied 2011 full text labels exactly `Conjecture 4.10`: for \(v_{r,s,t,n}\), both Theorem 4.8 families \(\{s_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq((i+a)^b,i^{j-b})\}\) and \(\{s_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq(i^j,b^a)\}\) are minimal, where \(i=s-t+1\), \(j=r-t+1\), \(a=\min(n-r-i,r-j)\), and \(b=\min(i,j)\). [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 847-892; lines 938-946]
- [source-backed] The supplied 2011 full text labels `Question 5.1`: “Can one find a minimal generating set for the ideal \(I_w\) in type \(A_{n-1}\)?” and asks this at least for inclusion-defined \(X_w\), avoiding \(\{4231,35142,42513,351624\}\), and smooth \(X_w\), avoiding \(\{3412,4231\}\). [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 1143-1156]
- [unsupported] The required source-ID binding and exhaustive source-30/source-29 inspection are unavailable: `source-30` is explicitly reported non-citable, and no bounded indexed record identifies either candidate full text as persisted `source-30` or `source-29`. Thus the requested exhaustive coverage and itemwise source-29 zero-status check cannot be certified.
- [computed] Artifact `f1ea7b8a6c15d6654b7e1bd1673dd88e63c0753a417251ed8a5fd4e756dc86f9` is task-owned but nonqualifying: independent review records that it only reproduces hardcoded literals and does not capture a provider record. No qualifying task-owned source-refresh artifact was persisted. [artifact f1ea7b8a6c15d6654b7e1bd1673dd88e63c0753a417251ed8a5fd4e756dc86f9]

## Strategy
Use the supplied provider full-text record for bounded external grounding; do not infer the unavailable persisted-source mapping.

## Gaps
The requested certificate is **not established**: no citable inspection of `source-30`/`source-29`, no exhaustive label audit bound to those IDs, and no qualifying task-owned capture artifact exist.
